svg.text: Physical reconstruction + proposed observation system | configuration CFG-V2-R1 | mechanical basis CAD-R3
CONFIRMED = stated scope only | CONFLICTING = evidence disagrees | PROPOSED = intent | UNKNOWN = insufficient evidence
MECHANICAL / OWNER-CONFIRMED RELATIONSHIPS; ALL NUMERIC DIMENSIONS UNMEASURED
POWER + OBSERVATION / ROUTES ARE LOGICAL HYPOTHESES, NOT TRACED WIRES
REVIEW BOUNDARY / PHYSICAL OBSERVATIONS, DESIGN INTENT AND CODE EVIDENCE STAY SEPARATE
Photo + source scope; not an inspection
Gray rectangular frame stays on chassis.
Indoor / outdoor hardware is the same.
Joint detail, sections and dimensions open.
Normal hinge at opposite / rear end.
Tub tips; outer frame stays stationary.
Axis position, latch and travel open.
Blue KBT adapter in historical media.
Actual pack label / cutoff / polarity open.
White front lights; red rim light strips.
No validated heading or obstacle control.
No vehicle motion commands in draft.
Board identity only; not pin/deployment proof
Fitted board, OS and power entry open.
Owner confirms Uno identity and mechanical
appearance; they do not measure dimensions.
Bucket omitted from CAD by display request;
this is not a claim it was absent in operation.
Trace power entries, returns and connector views.
Recover running sketch and sample its serial output.
Identify Pi / sensor boards; inspect current fit.
Measure mounts, hinge and moving clearances.
No link from Pi / Uno to ESC is established.
V2 reconstruction is the present review scope.
Posters are concepts, not installation evidence.
Autonomy, sorting, RTK and intake upgrades
and performance claims are not validated.
